Threat: Unauthorized access due to misconfigured S3 buckets
Vulnerability: No automated cloud security posture monitoring; manual config reviews only
Existing Controls: Manual quarterly config review; IAM least-privilege on paper

Vulnerability: No mandatory phishing simulation or security awareness training program

Threat: Data exfiltration by a malicious or compromised insider
Vulnerability: Shared database credentials used by multiple engineers; no query-level audit logging
Existing Controls: Database access restricted to engineering team via VPN

Threat: Vendor breach exposing PHI shared for analytics processing
Vulnerability: No formal vendor risk assessment or PHI data processing agreements on file for 2 of 6 subprocessors
Existing Controls: Standard MSA in place; no security-specific due diligence

Threat: Introduction of malicious code via compromised dependency or pipeline secret leak
Vulnerability: Pipeline secrets stored as plain repo secrets; no dependency scanning (SCA) in place
Existing Controls: Branch protection rules enabled; PR review required

Threat: Former employee retains access to systems after termination
Vulnerability: Offboarding checklist exists but is manual and not consistently followed
Existing Controls: HR notifies IT via email on termination

Threat: Ransomware renders production and backup data unrecoverable
Vulnerability: Backups are automated but never tested via a full restore drill
Existing Controls: Daily automated AWS backups with 30-day retention

Threat: Loss or theft of an unencrypted laptop containing PHI extracts
Vulnerability: Full-disk encryption policy exists but is not centrally enforced/verified
Existing Controls: Laptop encryption recommended in onboarding checklist

Threat: Exploitation of an unpatched web application vulnerability
Vulnerability: No web application firewall (WAF); ad hoc dependency patching

Threat: Non-compliance with PCI-DSS scope leading to fines or processor termination
Vulnerability: Payment data handling not formally reviewed against PCI-DSS since integrating billing vendor
Existing Controls: Third-party payment processor (Stripe) used; no cardholder data stored directly

Threat: Data exposure via use of personal/unmanaged devices accessing company systems
Vulnerability: No formal BYOD policy or device management (MDM) for contractors
Existing Controls: Okta MFA required for all logins

Threat: Unauthorized or untested production changes causing an outage
Vulnerability: No formal change advisory process; deploys approved informally in Slack
Existing Controls: PR review and CI tests required before merge

Threat: Unauthorized physical access to the shared co-working office
Vulnerability: Shared co-working space managed by third-party building operator
Existing Controls: Badge access controlled by building operator

Threat: Inability to demonstrate compliance to customers/auditors
Vulnerability: No centralized policy repository or version control for security documentation
Existing Controls: Policies exist but are stored in scattered shared drives
